ranking: GitHub stars among this editorial shortlist; not a quality score or Baltor usage count.

items.name: Context7
items.reason: Retrieve documentation and examples for the library a coding task actually uses.
items.caution: Check the selected library and version. Documentation retrieval does not test generated code.

items.name: Playwright MCP
items.reason: Give a coding harness browser interactions for debugging and checking a web experience.
items.caution: Browser access can expose signed-in pages and trigger changes. Use a scoped browser profile.

items.name: GitHub MCP Server
items.reason: Let a harness inspect repository context and use supported GitHub operations.
items.caution: Enable only the toolsets and account permissions needed for the task.

items.name: MCP for Blender
items.task: Inspect and edit a Blender scene
items.reason: A community bridge for object, material and scene operations inside Blender.
items.caution: It can execute Python in Blender. Keep the connection local and test changes on a copy of the project.

items.name: n8n MCP
items.reason: A community integration that supplies n8n node information and workflow-building operations.
items.caution: This is not n8n's own server. Workflow management depends on the connected instance and its credentials.

items.name: Firecrawl MCP Server
items.reason: Use supported search and extraction operations to gather information for a research task.
items.caution: Service access and usage charges are separate from Baltor. Source access and reuse restrictions still apply.
